title: Meridian Netserve - Company Profile
text: Meridian Netserve Pvt. Ltd. was incorporated in Pune in 2019 under the Companies Act, 2013 and operates a shared network monitoring desk in Pune staffed on a 12x6 basis (08:00 to 20:00, Monday to Saturday). As of 31 December 2024 it had 95 employees on payroll and a standalone turnover of Rs 6.2 Cr in FY 2021-22, Rs 8.9 Cr in FY 2022-23 and Rs 11.4 Cr in FY 2023-24, an average of Rs 8.8 Cr.

title: Audited Financial Summary FY 2021-22 to FY 2023-24
text: Audited statements certified by the statutory auditor show net profit after tax of Rs 0.3 Cr (FY 2021-22), a loss of Rs 0.4 Cr (FY 2022-23) and net profit of Rs 0.6 Cr (FY 2023-24). Figures are for Meridian as an individual company.

title: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System Certificate
text: Meridian holds ISO 9001:2015 certification for IT support and network monitoring services at its Pune facility, issued on 3 June 2023 after an initial certification audit. The certificate is valid for three years.

title: ISO/IEC 27001 Certification - Application Status
text: Meridian's information security management system documentation was submitted to a certification body in September 2024. A stage 1 readiness audit was completed; the stage 2 certification audit has not yet been scheduled. No certificate has been issued.

title: Udyam (MSME) Registration Certificate
text: Meridian is registered as a Micro Enterprise under the MSME Udyam registration scheme for IT services, with registration dated 11 February 2020.

title: Branch Network Support - Regional Co-operative Bank
text: Between June 2021 and May 2024 Meridian provided remote monitoring and L1 support for Client-P covering 210 routers and switches across 58 branches and 120 MPLS links from two service providers. Monthly uptime reports for FY 2023-24 recorded 98.1% availability.

title: Helpdesk and Desktop Support - Logistics Firm
text: Since March 2022 Meridian has run a shared IT helpdesk for Client-Q covering 1,400 desktops and laptops at 24 locations, with ticket handling through a cloud ITSM tool. The purchase order runs to February 2026.

title: Structured Cabling - Manufacturing Plant
text: During 2023 Meridian laid and tested 420 Cat6 copper ports and 18 fibre links at Client-R's plant in Chakan, with as-built drawings handed over on completion.

title: Managed Services Agreement - Client-S (Confidential)
text: Under an April 2023 agreement Meridian provides network monitoring for Client-S across 340 devices at 71 sites. The agreement prohibits disclosure of the client's identity, contract value or scope to any third party without written consent.

title: Certified Staff on Payroll - Summary
text: As of 31 December 2024 Meridian's payroll included 11 CCNA and 1 CCNP certified employees. No CCIE or PMP certified staff are currently on payroll.

title: Profile - Lead Network Engineer (Emp. MN-204)
text: B.E. engineer, CCNP Enterprise certified in 2022, with 2 years' post-CCNP experience on routing, switching and MPLS. Served as technical lead on the Client-P engagement.

title: Profile - Monitoring Engineer (Emp. MN-311)
text: Diploma engineer with CCNA certified in 2023, with 1.5 years' experience monitoring WAN links during day shifts. Handles link-down escalations with service providers.

title: Monitoring Desk Capability
text: Meridian's monitoring desk runs 12x6 with an open-source NMS, retains device syslogs online for 30 days and archives them for 12 months. Incident and change processes follow an internal SOP; there is no formal ITIL certification. Out-of-hours incidents are handled by an on-call rota reached by phone.

title: Personnel and Staffing Policy
text: Meridian staff complete background verification before deployment and sign confidentiality undertakings. About 20% of field engineering work is delivered through vetted sub-contractors on a per-site basis.

title: Declaration - Blacklisting and Penalty History
text: Meridian has not been blacklisted by any government body, PSU, bank or other entity between January 2022 and December 2024. One client applied a service-credit deduction of 4% of the quarterly fee in FY 2023-24 for missed response times.

title: Transition Approach
text: Meridian's transition approach runs in three phases (planning, shadowing and handover) and has been used on 3 support takeovers since 2021, with steady-state reached in a median of 42 days.

title: ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 IT Service Management Certificate
text: Meridian's IT service management system for its monitoring desk was certified to ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 on 10 January 2021. The certificate lapsed and has not been renewed.

title: Data Centre Experience Note
text: Meridian has not operated or managed a tier-rated data centre. Its monitoring desk is hosted in a leased office with a UPS and a diesel generator, and is not a certified facility.
